description: This risk arises when the memory component of an agentic system is intentionally or inadvertently populated with malicious, misleading, or corrupted information. As a result, the agent may rely on compromised memory to make decisions, propagate false information, or exhibit persistent unsafe behaviour across interactions.

controls.statement: Implement allowlists and denylists to restrict what categories of information can be written to the agent's persistent memory
Implement content filtering on writes to persistent memory to detect and block known unsafe content patterns
Log all modifications to persistent memory with comprehensive source metadata for audit purposes
